predict.question: You have 30 minutes for a report. Before each 5-minute chunk of writing, 5 minutes of urgent admin lands on you. How many minutes of report writing fit?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Scarcity argues pressing shortages can capture attention and leave less for other demands.
modelBoundary: Admin leaves {A} for task chunks; removing it leaves {B}. The consumed time is explicit, not an estimated cognitive penalty.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Scarcity’s real attentional effects are not established by this scheduling identity.
